usedFor: Shopify takes your orders and Reckon One keeps your books, so “New Order” runs “Create Receipt”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Receipt” in Reckon One
bestTemplate.why: Each sale is recorded as a money-in receipt, so your books follow the store.

watchOut: Nothing here reverses “Create Receipt” if a Shopify order is later cancelled, so handle that by hand.
